label: Promo C (P-C) deck-code entities the game itself wrote
what: Deck-code (QR) entities for four Promo C printings, read from a real in-game deck QR. Kept apart from lib/c1_provisional_entities.json (its counts and build are untouched) and from the catalog. lib/encode_qr.py and lib/decode_qr.py read it through lib/check_c1_overlay.py load_promo(), only for ids and entities the catalog lacks (the catalog always wins). Only numbers the game wrote are here: no guesses.
source: from the owner's in-game QR, Nov 18 2026 ('New deck 4'); raw payload AZic/BMAWXQAVxwAV5QAV54AV3YAWD4AWGYAVb4AWCAAWWAAVUYAVq4AWI4AWc4AV04AWboAWMoAV0QAVnIDBQcG
evidence: Re-encoding the deck's 20 cards by these ids gives a payload byte-identical to the scanned one (lib/test_promo_c.py). Which new number belongs to which card comes from slot position (the other 17 Pokemon slots follow the screen order exactly); the bytes alone do not name the card.
left_out: P-C 004 Inkay (22980 is a spacing guess only), P-C 006 Cosmog, P-C 007 Cosmoem (no promo badge on the scanned Cosmoem), P-C 009 Genome Converter Y: not established; they stay refused by encode_qr.
